same_antigen_different_antibody.panel_selection: label-free exact antigen sequence identity with different antibody sequence and antibody cluster; deterministic maximum 31 alternates per focal
same_antigen_different_antibody.primary_stratum: both complexes contain at least one positive epitope residue and true epitope Jaccard is at most 0.50
same_antigen_different_antibody.directed_assignment_margin: 0.5 * ([AP(cognate map,focal target)-AP(cognate map,alternate target)] + [AP(swapped map,alternate target)-AP(swapped map,focal target)])
same_antigen_different_antibody.success_guard: both directional assignment margins must be positive; arbitrary map change is not success

zero_positive_policy.pooled_metrics: retain every candidate and residue from zero-positive complexes
zero_positive_policy.positive_required_macro_metrics: mark per-complex AP and ranked recall ineligible rather than silently assign zero or delete the complex
zero_positive_policy.reporting: include eligible count, ineligible count, explicit instance IDs, and policy text

final_clean_metrics.contact: pooled AUPRC/AUROC/precision/recall/F1/MCC/Brier/ECE-15/reliability/calibration slope plus positive-eligible mean per-complex AUPRC and P@K/recall@K
final_clean_metrics.marginals: pooled epitope and paratope discrimination, threshold metrics, Brier, ECE-15, reliability, calibration intercept/slope, and positive-eligible mean per-complex AUPRC
final_clean_metrics.macro_uncertainty: 10000-replicate antigen-cluster bootstrap for contact and epitope; antibody-cluster bootstrap for paratope; never labeled as pooled-AUPRC confidence intervals
final_clean_metrics.specificity: both reciprocal interaction-only margins, top-1, mean reciprocal rank, median rank, and 10000-replicate cluster bootstrap
final_clean_metrics.calibration_source: temperatures and thresholds frozen on validation only; final calibration regression is descriptive and never modifies predictions

independent_monomer_se3.comparison: every clean contact, interaction-only, epitope, and paratope probability element

validation_gpu_smoke.claim_boundary: Randomly initialized validation-only execution and invariance proof, not model performance.

claim_boundary: This receipt freezes SAbDab2 evaluation semantics and code before any persisted or user-observed antigen-fold validation result. It contains no biological performance result and does not authorize an A100, external-test, state-of-the-art, or CHIMERA co-design claim.
